Name: Gil and Morris as Furniture
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
Stardew Valley's best characters: Gil and Morris. We love them dearly, but there's a severe lack of both of them in the game. Gil only exists in the Adventurer's Guild and Morris only exists in Joja Mart. It's a tragedy that needs to be remedied, and so I have taken the liberty of fixing it myself. Now you can have them wherever you want! 

Morris blinks and Gil rocks back and forth in his rocking chair! 

I have no idea why anyone would want this but I realized I could do it so I did. Enjoy?

Manifest.Name: Gil and Morris but Furniture
Manifest.Description: Gil and Morris but now you can have them forever
